---
title: "Prior interaction evidence for the AP-MS bait isoforms (BioGRID and IntAct)"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

The 13 risk/nonrisk isoform pairs tested by AP-MS are encoded by genes that have, in
most cases, been studied before, so the novelty of the isoform-resolved interactome
depends on the resolution at which earlier interaction data were recorded. This script
establishes, for every bait isoform, (1) whether the bait gene has any physical
interaction recorded in BioGRID and how many of those records come from affinity-capture
MS, (2) whether the bait isoform itself is structurally annotated (SQANTI full or
incomplete splice match) or novel (novel in catalog / novel not in catalog), and (3)
whether IntAct holds any isoform-specific record (`accession-N`) for the gene. The three
signals are combined into one verdict per bait isoform. Because BioGRID files genes under
official symbols that may differ from the symbols used in the bait list, gene names are
resolved to Entrez identifiers through BioGRID's own symbol and synonym columns together
with a small alias table.

**Manuscript outputs produced**

- Methods, "Interaction scoring and network annotation": prior evidence assessed against
  BioGRID at the gene level (aliases and Entrez identifiers resolved) and against IntAct
  for isoform-specific records.
- Results, Fig. 5 text: all 13 bait genes carry gene-level BioGRID records and none has an
  isoform-specific record, so earlier interactions either represent the canonical isoform
  or do not specify the isoform tested.

**Inputs**

- `F_BIOGRID_TAB3` — BioGRID human release 5.0.252, TAB3 format (public).
- `F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS` — the 13 bait pairs with gene symbol and risk/nonrisk PacBio accessions.
- `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM` — SQANTI Protein classification with transcript category and CPM.
- `F_INTACT_RECORDS` — stored result of the IntAct PSICQUIC query (see Section 5). Read when
  `QUERY_INTACT` is `FALSE` (default); regenerated when `TRUE`.

**Outputs**

- `OUT_BAIT_NOVELTY` (`bait_isoform_novelty_table.csv`) — one row per bait isoform with
  the BioGRID metrics, structural novelty, IntAct status and verdict.
- `F_INTACT_RECORDS` — rewritten only when the live IntAct query is run.

**Run order** — independent of the other scripts; requires only the input files above.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r config}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

# IntAct is a live web service, so the deposited query result is used by default. Setting
# QUERY_INTACT to TRUE re-runs the PSICQUIC query and overwrites F_INTACT_RECORDS; the
# stored table reflects IntAct content at the date it was generated.
QUERY_INTACT <- FALSE

require_files(F_BIOGRID_TAB3, F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS, F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM)
if (!QUERY_INTACT) require_files(F_INTACT_RECORDS)
ensure_dir(RES_09)
```

## 1. Gene aliases

BioGRID records some bait genes under a different official symbol than the one used in the
bait list (for example `NHERF2` is filed as `SLC9A3R2`, and `COA8` has several historical
names), so each bait gene is expanded to the set of names under which its records may be
filed. BioGRID's own synonym columns are searched in addition to this table.

```{r aliases}
ALIASES <- list(
  "SLC9A3R2"     = c("NHERF2"),
  "NHERF2"       = c("SLC9A3R2"),
  "RP11-77K12.1" = c("CFDP1"),
  "CFDP1"        = c("RP11-77K12.1"),
  "COA8"         = c("C14orf153", "APOPT1", "APOP1", "APOP", "APOP-1", "MC4DN17", "MGC2562")
)
alias_set <- function(g) unique(toupper(str_trim(c(g, ALIASES[[g]]))))
```

## 2. Bait isoforms

The bait list holds one row per gene with the risk and nonrisk PacBio accessions in
separate columns; it is reshaped to one row per bait isoform so that every downstream
annotation is isoform-level. The PacBio columns are identified by content (values matching
`PB.x.y`) and the risk column is the one whose name does not contain "non".

```{r baits_long}
baits_raw <- read_csv(F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS, show_col_types = FALSE, name_repair = "minimal") %>%
  as_tibble()
names(baits_raw) <- sub("^﻿", "", names(baits_raw))   # the file carries a UTF-8 BOM

gene_col <- names(baits_raw)[grepl("gene", names(baits_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
desc_col <- names(baits_raw)[grepl("desc", names(baits_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
is_pb    <- vapply(baits_raw, function(c)
  mean(grepl("^PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", str_trim(as.character(c))), na.rm = TRUE) > 0.5,
  logical(1))
pb_cols     <- names(baits_raw)[is_pb]
risk_col    <- pb_cols[!grepl("non", pb_cols, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
nonrisk_col <- pb_cols[ grepl("non", pb_cols, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col), !is.na(risk_col), !is.na(nonrisk_col))

baits <- baits_raw %>%
  transmute(gene        = .data[[gene_col]],
            description = if (!is.na(desc_col)) .data[[desc_col]] else NA_character_,
            risk        = .data[[risk_col]],
            nonrisk     = .data[[nonrisk_col]]) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(risk, nonrisk), names_to = "side", values_to = "pb") %>%
  mutate(pb = str_trim(pb)) %>%
  filter(grepl("^PB\\.", pb))

stopifnot(n_distinct(baits$gene) == 13)
message(sprintf("Baits: %d genes, %d bait isoforms", n_distinct(baits$gene), nrow(baits)))
```

## 3. Structural novelty from SQANTI

An isoform is "annotated" if its transcript is a full or incomplete splice match to
GENCODE and "novel" if it is novel in catalog or novel not in catalog. Annotated here means
that some reference transcript matches, not necessarily the canonical one.

```{r sqanti_novelty}
sq <- fread(F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM) %>% as_tibble()
pb_field <- if ("pb" %in% names(sq)) "pb" else "pb_acc"
sq2 <- sq %>%
  transmute(pb     = .data[[pb_field]],
            cpm    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CPM)),
            tx_cat = as.character(tx_cat))

baits <- baits %>%
  left_join(sq2, by = "pb") %>%
  mutate(structural_novelty = case_when(
    tx_cat %in% c("full-splice_match", "incomplete-splice_match",
                  "full_splice_match", "incomplete_splice_match") ~ "annotated",
    grepl("novel", tx_cat, ignore.case = TRUE)                    ~ "novel",
    TRUE                                                          ~ NA_character_))
```

## 4. Gene-level BioGRID coverage

Only physical interactions are considered. Each bait gene is mapped to Entrez identifiers
by matching its alias set against BioGRID's official symbols and synonym lists, and every
record in which a matched Entrez identifier appears as interactor A or B is counted. Per
gene the number of interaction records, the number from affinity-capture MS, the number of
distinct partners and the number of distinct publications are recorded. The first
Swiss-Prot accession seen for the gene is retained for the IntAct query.

```{r biogrid_coverage}
message("Reading BioGRID TAB3 ...")
bg <- fread(F_BIOGRID_TAB3, sep = "\t", quote = "", showProgress = FALSE) %>% as_tibble()

symA <- "Official Symbol Interactor A"; symB <- "Official Symbol Interactor B"
spA  <- "SWISS-PROT Accessions Interactor A"; spB <- "SWISS-PROT Accessions Interactor B"
entA <- "Entrez Gene Interactor A"; entB <- "Entrez Gene Interactor B"
synA <- "Synonyms Interactor A";    synB <- "Synonyms Interactor B"
bg_phys <- bg %>% filter(.data[["Experimental System Type"]] == "physical")

target_names <- unique(unlist(lapply(unique(baits$gene), alias_set)))

# name -> Entrez index built from BioGRID's own official symbols and synonyms
name2entrez <- bind_rows(
  bg %>% transmute(entrez = .data[[entA]], sym = .data[[symA]], syn = .data[[synA]]),
  bg %>% transmute(entrez = .data[[entB]], sym = .data[[symB]], syn = .data[[synB]])
) %>%
  mutate(allnames = paste(sym, syn, sep = "|")) %>%
  separate_rows(allnames, sep = "\\|") %>%
  mutate(allnames = toupper(str_trim(allnames))) %>%
  filter(allnames %in% target_names) %>%
  distinct(allnames, entrez)

resolve_entrez <- function(g) unique(name2entrez$entrez[name2entrez$allnames %in% alias_set(g)])

gene_metrics <- map_dfr(unique(baits$gene), function(g) {
  ent  <- resolve_entrez(g)
  hits <- if (length(ent)) {
    bg_phys %>% filter(.data[[entA]] %in% ent | .data[[entB]] %in% ent)
  } else bg_phys[0, ]
  if (nrow(hits) == 0)
    return(tibble(gene = g, matched_entrez = paste(ent, collapse = ";"), uniprot_acc = NA_character_,
                  biogrid_n_interactions = 0L, biogrid_n_apms = 0L,
                  biogrid_n_partners = 0L, biogrid_n_pubs = 0L))
  is_a    <- hits[[entA]] %in% ent
  partner <- ifelse(is_a, hits[[symB]], hits[[symA]])
  acc_col <- ifelse(is_a, hits[[spA]],  hits[[spB]])
  acc_col <- acc_col[!is.na(acc_col) & acc_col != "-"]
  acc1    <- if (length(acc_col)) strsplit(acc_col[1], "\\|")[[1]][1] else NA_character_
  tibble(gene = g, matched_entrez = paste(ent, collapse = ";"), uniprot_acc = acc1,
         biogrid_n_interactions = nrow(hits),
         biogrid_n_apms         = sum(hits[["Experimental System"]] == "Affinity Capture-MS"),
         biogrid_n_partners     = n_distinct(partner),
         biogrid_n_pubs         = n_distinct(hits[["Publication Source"]]))
})
```

## 5. Isoform-specific records in IntAct

IntAct is the database that records interactions at isoform resolution, using UniProt
isoform accessions of the form `P12345-2`. Each gene is queried through the PSICQUIC REST
interface by its Swiss-Prot accession (more precise than a symbol that may be
non-standard), and any isoform accession among the interactor identifiers is recorded.
By default the stored query result is read; the live query runs only when `QUERY_INTACT`
is `TRUE`, and then rewrites the stored file.

```{r intact_query}
query_intact <- function(gene, acc) {
  q <- if (!is.na(acc)) acc else gene
  url <- sprintf(
    "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/Tools/webservices/psicquic/intact/webservices/current/search/query/%s?format=tab27",
    utils::URLencode(q))
  txt <- tryCatch(readLines(url, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) character(0))
  if (!length(txt) || is.na(acc))
    return(tibble(intact_isoform_record = NA, intact_isoforms_seen = NA_character_))
  ids <- unlist(lapply(strsplit(txt, "\t"), function(x) x[1:2]))
  pat <- paste0("uniprotkb:", acc, "-([0-9]+)")
  hit <- regmatches(ids, regexpr(pat, ids)); iso <- unique(hit[nchar(hit) > 0])
  tibble(intact_isoform_record = length(iso) > 0,
         intact_isoforms_seen  = if (length(iso)) paste(iso, collapse = ";") else "")
}

if (QUERY_INTACT) {
  message("Querying IntAct (online) ...")
  intact <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(gene_metrics)), function(i) {
    Sys.sleep(0.3)   # polite pacing of the web service
    cbind(gene = gene_metrics$gene[i],
          query_intact(gene_metrics$gene[i], gene_metrics$uniprot_acc[i]))
  }) %>% as_tibble()
  ensure_dir(dirname(F_INTACT_RECORDS))
  write_csv(intact, F_INTACT_RECORDS)
} else {
  intact <- read_csv(F_INTACT_RECORDS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(intact_isoform_record = as.logical(intact_isoform_record),
           intact_isoforms_seen  = as.character(intact_isoforms_seen))
  stopifnot(all(gene_metrics$gene %in% intact$gene))
}
```

## 6. Verdict per bait isoform

The three signals are ordered from least to most prior characterization: a gene absent
from BioGRID is uncharacterized; a structurally novel isoform of a studied gene has no
prior interaction data that could refer to it; an isoform-specific IntAct record is the
only case in which the isoform itself was previously characterized; otherwise the gene was
assayed (by AP-MS or another method) without resolving the isoform.

```{r assemble_verdict}
tbl <- baits %>%
  left_join(gene_metrics, by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(intact,       by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(gene_studied = biogrid_n_interactions > 0,
         verdict = case_when(
           !gene_studied & structural_novelty == "novel" ~ "Gene & isoform both uncharacterized",
           !gene_studied                                  ~ "Gene absent from BioGRID",
           structural_novelty == "novel"                  ~ "Gene studied; isoform NOVEL - no prior interaction data",
           intact_isoform_record %in% TRUE                ~ "Isoform-specific interactions reported (IntAct)",
           biogrid_n_apms > 0                             ~ "Gene assayed by AP-MS at canonical level; this isoform not resolved",
           TRUE                                           ~ "Gene studied (non-AP-MS); isoform not specifically assayed")) %>%
  select(gene, description, side, pb, cpm, tx_cat, structural_novelty,
         matched_entrez, uniprot_acc, gene_studied, biogrid_n_interactions, biogrid_n_apms,
         biogrid_n_partners, biogrid_n_pubs, intact_isoform_record, intact_isoforms_seen, verdict) %>%
  arrange(gene, side)

write_csv(tbl, OUT_BAIT_NOVELTY)
```

## 7. Summary

The counts below support the statement that prior interaction records for the bait genes
exist only at the gene level.

```{r novelty_summary}
cat(sprintf("Bait genes: %d | bait isoforms: %d\n", n_distinct(tbl$gene), nrow(tbl)))
cat(sprintf("Genes with any BioGRID physical interaction: %d / %d\n",
            sum(tapply(tbl$gene_studied,       tbl$gene, any)), n_distinct(tbl$gene)))
cat(sprintf("Genes with BioGRID affinity-capture MS records: %d / %d\n",
            sum(tapply(tbl$biogrid_n_apms > 0, tbl$gene, any)), n_distinct(tbl$gene)))
cat(sprintf("Bait isoforms structurally novel (NIC/NNC): %d / %d\n",
            sum(tbl$structural_novelty == "novel", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(tbl)))
cat(sprintf("Bait isoforms with an isoform-specific IntAct record: %d\n",
            sum(tbl$intact_isoform_record %in% TRUE)))
print(count(tbl, verdict))
```
